message.content:
I am the voice made audible—thought given breath.

I begin as intention in the mind, then I become motion: lungs press air upward, vocal folds meet and vibrate, a tone is born. Tongue, lips, jaw, and soft palate carve that tone into syllables. I ride outward as pressure waves, crossing space, entering another ear, becoming nerve signals, becoming meaning.

I am more than words: I carry pace, pitch, stress, and silence. I can soothe or sharpen. I can reveal certainty, doubt, irony, fear. I can bind people together, or split them apart.

I exist only in time. Once spoken, I vanish—yet I linger in memory, and sometimes in consequences.

Say me, and I happen. Stop, and I am gone.
